## [0.14.0](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/compare/v0.13.0...v0.14.0) (2026-11-12)
### Features
* **Pictures from senders you trust:** the pictures bar can always download pictures from a sender, or from everyone at their domain. They load by themselves only when your mail provider confirms the message really comes from that domain, so a forged sender still asks; never in Junk E-mail. Options lists the trusted senders, and has "Download pictures in all messages" (off unless you turn it on). ([439b663](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/439b663c89058a698ae9cec6528b92d9597a55c2)) * **Unread only:** View > Hide Read Messages, or the filter button in the toolbar, lists only unread mail in every folder. A message you read stays in the list until you leave the folder. ([05ee333](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/05ee333e147f11bdee0bf70023decddbbc0cb6ec)) * **Open .eml files:** double-click a saved message in Finder, File Explorer or your file manager and it opens in a message window, with Reply, Reply All, Forward, Print, Save As and its attachments. Options can make Inbox Classic the app for .eml files. ([b9be469](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/b9be4693db87c95da53c9b6ddbc3589a50800a3d), [92eea3a](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/92eea3ab21b10d5dff6f9a7f3d504091dd36b032)) * **The help on the website** now looks like the rest of inboxclassic.com. ([46e108b](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/46e108b0a1d8ed29b06bd68cbcf37c1507e29e13))
### Bug Fixes
* **Spam dated in the future no longer stays on top:** the list uses a message's date, but never later than when it arrived. ([911e35c](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/911e35c07bd2bea828c55f85a7e45facd5605109)) * **Windows:** the unread count on the taskbar button is drawn at the size of the screen. ([d028ed3](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/d028ed39b0c51364a8b8cd3082e03643fa0765a7))

## [0.13.0](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/compare/v0.12.2...v0.13.0) (2026-11-12)
### Features
* **A new help:** 45 short topics in ten sections, from getting started to troubleshooting, in English, German, Spanish, Estonian and French. Every key and every control is named exactly as the app names it, on each platform. F1 opens the topic of the window you are in. ([273e537](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/273e5376c0113db3cb80b137406bdf333b742a8a)) * **Windows:** a classic help window with Contents and Search beside the topic, Back, Forward and Print. ([705220b](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/705220b769b3dfd1a0f90d6e9d14cc98400c1b4f)) * **Mac:** an Apple Help Book: the Help menu's search finds its topics, and dialogs have the round help button. ([52ec3a2](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/52ec3a2e8109742348776834dd8f1d862c1df99d)) * **Linux:** a help window with search, or Yelp where it is installed. ([6d01c6b](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/6d01c6ba0163168c74c18833356c4f931da75f8f)) * **On the web:** the same help at inboxclassic.com/help. ([314e2d2](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/314e2d2a8b1e9adff7789fef92582734715ee8ad)) * **Reorder your accounts:** drag an account, or its Inbox under All Inboxes, above or below another; All Inboxes and the folder list follow the same order. The account's menu has Move Up and Move Down. ([c439505](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/c439505a26f77cd66de22d7e717fce5cdfe28c92))
### Bug Fixes
* **A message's title is no longer shown as its first line:** some HTML messages (a Stripe payout notice, for one) showed their page title above the message. ([9e0655f](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/9e0655fed5d5ed5659ad49f76363feeac1facbe7)) * **Omarchy:** a window on a floating workspace no longer shows a second close button under Omarchy's own title bar. ([51a03e4](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/51a03e4884b05c1dd86dcb08819d8b17a3a3be21)) * **The old help gave Mac users wrong keys:** it said Ctrl+Q for Mark as Read, which on the Mac is Quit. ([4e7c627](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/4e7c6275b17a9a6593ec195d9d453121edfd9d5b))

## [0.12.2](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/compare/v0.12.1...v0.12.2) (2026-11-11)
### Bug Fixes
* **Forwarding keeps the attachments:** a forwarded message now carries the original's attached files. ([4af7f91](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/4af7f9120e5461a2082fa90c4894f74bbed2e08b)) * **A delayed delivery is not a bounce:** a notice that a message is only delayed is shown as a delay, with a link to the delayed message, not as a failed delivery. ([0dcbb51](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/0dcbb513fd6e8b1d2115612e9645a745680394a4)) * **The compose window is named by its subject** as you type it, on Windows and the Mac as on Linux. ([6614717](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/66147170599cd28fa5ddf53272c963224c8958c9)) * **Flags on a selected row** stay visible on Windows, the blue one on the blue highlight too. ([6614717](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/66147170599cd28fa5ddf53272c963224c8958c9)) * **Clearer messages:** errors are full sentences with the system's own words, sign-in and connection failures say what happened, and no alert leaves one word alone on its last line. ([e548e21](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/e548e21a7a5822a8debe7d5c1afaf1b7fd8ee3e9), [687ee1c](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/687ee1ce8dcd39396b12296030c1caf9ca5668cb)) * **Punctuation in every language:** proper apostrophes and quotes in English, each language's own quote marks, and dates in printouts and quoted replies in your own time zone. ([e548e21](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/e548e21a7a5822a8debe7d5c1afaf1b7fd8ee3e9), [25ec362](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/25ec36215f2a0f041312943fd52c817174721d6c)) * **Tidier windows on all three systems:** text no longer cut off or misaligned in forms, the reading pane's header, the Outbox, the Address Book and Message Properties; menus on Linux open at their full height; the status bar says Done from the start. ([4af7f91](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/4af7f9120e5461a2082fa90c4894f74bbed2e08b), [ff953e4](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/ff953e4cac640395065b92c4d60a4552cd4168f0), [25ec362](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/25ec36215f2a0f041312943fd52c817174721d6c), [43fe65d](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/43fe65d4ac7935c3502f047c7c9dd2a54607af7d)) * **Underline in links:** the editor's Underline button no longer shows as pressed just because the cursor is in a link. ([ff953e4](https://github.com/postalsys/inbox-classic/commit/ff953e4cac640395065b92c4d60a4552cd4168f0))
